# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_1-2DTE_FIXED_EXIT

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Using the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger at 1-2 DTE weekly options (instead of 0DTE) with a fixed -8% stop and +30% target captures the edge of the signal while reducing the impact of 0DTE-specific noise (such as wide spreads and theta decay) and improving the win rate and profit factor, as evidenced by the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE finding which showed OOS $59-66/tr with p<=0.045 for 1-2 DTE.

## Mechanism

Entry: same as BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence with multi-day or premarket structure) but only when the selected weekly option has 1-2 days to expiration.  
Contract: ITM-2 put (same strike as base signal).  
Exit: fixed stop at -8% of entry premium and fixed target at +30% of entry premium. Exit at the end of the day if neither is hit by 15:50 ET.  
Position sizing: same as base signal (minimum 3 contracts, scaling with account size per risk-rules.md).
